faq_question_cost: What does it cost to work with your company for a renovation?
faq_answer_cost:
Most of our projects fall between $350–$950 per square foot, with a smaller number—around 20%—exceeding $1,000 per square foot.

This range reflects more than just materials and labor; it speaks to the level of detail, customization, and coordination each build requires. We use per-square-foot pricing as a general framework to help clients understand the investment behind their space.

A 1,000-square-foot build at $100 per square foot, for instance, would total around $100,000. But that figure shifts based on finish level, complexity, and intent. High-end finishes, architectural detailing, or unique constraints naturally raise the rate. Simpler scopes come in lower.

Either way, we approach every project with the same commitment to clarity, precision, and craft.
faq_answer_services:
As builders, our role goes far beyond managing timelines and budgets. We interpret architectural intent, coordinate trades, oversee site logistics, and ensure every detail aligns with the highest standards of safety, quality, and craftsmanship.

We work closely with clients, architects, engineers, and inspectors to ensure each structure is not only built to code—but built with integrity.

From solving on-site challenges to maintaining seamless workflows, we stay grounded in the belief that how something is built matters just as much as what gets built.
faq_question_fit: Is Homlistic the right fit for your next build?
faq_answer_fit:
We know we’re not the right builder for everyone—and honestly, that’s okay..

At Homlistic, the projects we’re most proud of happen when there’s a real connection—when we’re on the same page about communication, expectations, and values. That’s why we’re careful about who we work with, and why we take the time to listen and understand what matters most to you before we ever start building.

We’re probably a good fit if you:
  • Care more about quality than shortcuts
  • Want honesty and transparency, not guesswork
  • See building as a collaboration, not just a transaction
  • Appreciate clear timelines, and thoughtful execution

For us, it’s not just about what we build—it’s about how we build it, together.
homlistic_description:
Homlistic was founded on a simple but meaningful belief: in an industry that can sometimes feel opaque, we choose to lead with honesty and transparency.

As a construction management and general contracting firm dedicated to the highest level of craftsmanship, Homlistic approaches every project with intention, integrity, and deep respect—for bothpeople and process. This philosophy is at the heart of everything we do.

The name Homlistic—a blend of 'home' and 'holistic'—reflects this philosophy. It represents a building experience that is thoughtful and complete, one that goes beyond luxury finishes to focus on how every element comes together seamlessly and beautifully.

The result is more than just a home—it’s a harmonious creation, where craftsmanship reveals the true beauty of the design and brings the vision to life.
